result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. The cli module compiles and packages, but I could not run the help output: the sandbox started refusing `java` launches partway through, so the help text is verified by reading the code only.

Changes:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION`. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` alongside `updateLandscape`.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatcher routes either name to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. Its `-help` now prints the name the user typed, with the analyze description when that is the name typed and the unchanged `updateLandscape` description otherwise.
- **`README.md`**: added a short "Landscape report" section with both command descriptions and the shared options. The README had no per-command descriptions before, so this section is new.

I did not touch `CLAUDE.md`, which still lists only `updateLandscape` in its command overview. The cli module has no tests, so there was nothing to run beyond the compile and package.
